impact.text: Every new veTRUST locker who does not interact with MultiVault during their first claimable epoch loses 70% of that epoch's rewards

precondition_sources.text: Alice locks 100,000 wrapped TRUST in epoch N as her first-ever lock.
Alice had no veTRUST before epoch N, so eligible[epoch N-1] = 0.
userClaimedRewardsForEpoch[Alice][epoch N-1] = 0 because she never claimed.
Alice never calls deposit or redeem on MultiVault, so personalUtilization[user][*] = 0 and rawUtilizationDelta = 0.

intent_sources.text: A first-ever claimant with nothing claimable last epoch (target == 0 and eligible[prev] == 0) should receive 100% personal utilization rather than the 30% lower bound.
